answer: Proof of Personhood serves as the kernel of Sybil resistance, requiring agents to solve cryptographic challenges linked to human biometric data. Each verified identity acts like an ember that must be sustained by staking native tokens. Any attempt to fabricate a comet of thousands of fake identities becomes prohibitively expensive, as the cost of provisioning unique, non-duplicable proofs far outweighs the marginal influence gained within the decentralized consensus network.
